defs.def: to make sth or sb ready to be used or to do sth 使做好准备；把 … 预备好

ex.s: select workshops for their parentsB. prepare track topics for the camp
ex.t: 哈蒙德指的是意义的问题，而意义是将智力最低的人类与最聪明的机器区分开来的核心。

ex.s: They are more convenient to prepare.
ex.t: 它们准备起来更方便。

ex.s: Still, looking back on the photos, they are some of my best shots though they could have been so much better if I would have been prepared and managed my time wisely.
ex.t: 尽管如此，回头看这些照片，它们仍是我最好的作品之一，不过如果我准备充分、合理安排时间，它们本可以好得多。

ex.s: To prepare for a new career
ex.t: 为了准备一份新职业。

ex.s: She said: “I used to keep hens when I was younger and had to prepare their breakfast each morning before I went to school. ”
ex.t: 她说："我年轻时也养过母鸡，每天早上上学前得给它们准备早餐。"

ex.s: prepare problem sets in groupsD. use their skills to solve problems
ex.t: 准备问题集D. 运用技能解决问题

ex.s: They should also prepare plenty of reusable bags to carry their "new" clothes home.
ex.t: 他们还应该准备大量可重复使用的袋子，把"新"衣服运回家。

ex.s: Be prepared to have awkward conversations with strangers
ex.t: 准备好与陌生人进行尴尬的对话。

ex.s: 4. ______ us prepare for the exam, the teacher suggested reading through our notes. （    ）
ex.t: 4. ______帮我们准备考试，老师建议通读我们的笔记。（    ）

ex.s: As we organized teams, prepared resources and practiced answering questions, I felt more connected than I ever had to any sports team.
ex.t: 当我们组队、准备资源并练习回答问题时，我感觉比以往任何时候都更融入任何一支运动队。

ex.s: B．To prepare for a history competition．
ex.t: 上午7:00 - 上午9:00 参赛者在体育馆签到

ex.s: Preparing Cities for Robot Cars
ex.t: 他们开着自动驾驶汽车赴约，让空车绕着建筑物转圈以避免支付停车费。

ex.s: The movie is set in a small town where the only movie theater is preparing to close down.
ex.t: 这部电影设定在一个小镇上，那里唯一的电影院正准备关闭。

ex.s: After two months we were all prepared and ready to go on stage.
ex.t: 两个月后，我们都准备好了，可以登台了。

ex.s: People prepare decorations with flowers and dance around maypoles.
ex.t: 人们用鲜花装饰，围着五月柱跳舞。

ex.s: But to celebrate this festival, we prepare Chinese dishes, too.
ex.t: 但为了庆祝这个节日，我们也准备了中国菜。

ex.s: These social emotions prepare our brains to shape our behaviour according to the norms and values of our family and our community.
ex.t: 这些社会情感使我们的大脑做好准备,根据我们家庭和社区的规范和价值观塑造我们的行为。

ex.s: prepare students for their future jobs
ex.t: 使学生为将来的工作做好准备;

ex.s: When asked what advice he’d give other entrepreneurial youth, he says, “Prepare and have your family’s support.
ex.t: 当被问及会给其他创业青年什么建议时，他说：“做好准备，并获得家人的支持。”

ex.s: Summers in the mid-70s were spent at home shooting baskets, hitting a baseball, or throwing a football, preparing for my future as a quarterback on a football team.
ex.t: 70年代中期的夏天，我都在家里投篮、打棒球或扔橄榄球，为我将来当橄榄球队四分卫做准备。

ex.s: Preparing for a party.
ex.t: 为派对做准备。

ex.s: Keep calm and be prepared.
ex.t: 保持冷静并做好准备。

ex.s: So we still need to prepare food and drinks I'll make a checklist Preparation choose presents for Grandma draw up the guest list on Wednesday make invitations prepare food and drinks on Sunday morning Who's responsible?
ex.t: 所以我们还需要准备食物和饮料。我来列个清单：准备——给奶奶选礼物；星期三拟好客人名单；做邀请函；准备食物和饮料；星期天早上——谁负责？

ex.s: Be prepared to be corrected by student B The classification of household waste aims to help people separate different types of waste.
ex.t: 为学生B的纠正做好准备生活垃圾的分类旨在帮助人们分离不同类型的垃圾。

ex.s: To me, that was the biggest thing ever and I soon learned the whole poem by heart, well prepared for our first rehearsal.
ex.t: 对我来说，那是有史以来最了不起的事，我很快就背下了整首诗，为我们第一次排练做好了充分准备。

ex.s: I thought that we would just be passing out dinners to those in need, but I found out we would be doing everything from preparing to serving the dinner.
ex.t: 我以为我们只是分发晚餐给那些需要帮助的人，但我发现我们要做的事情从准备到服务晚餐无所不包。

ex.s: Do you want to get up in time to have breakfast with your family, get in some exercise, or just be better prepared for your day?
ex.t: 你是想按时起床和家人一起吃早餐、做些运动，还是想更好地为新的一天做准备？

ex.s: Mabry works circles around all the students， cleaning up messes others don't want to touch． He doesn't expect a lot． Mabry said he hadn't planned to do much for his milestone birthday，so he was happy the students had prepared the surprise celebration．
ex.t: 马布里围着所有学生忙碌，清理别人不愿碰的脏乱。他要求不多。马布里说他原本没有打算为这个里程碑式的生日做什么，所以学生们准备了这场惊喜庆祝活动，他很高兴。

ex.s: In Save Money: Good Food, she visits a different home each week and with the help of chef Matt Tebbutt offers top tips on how to reduce food waste, while preparing recipes for under £5 per family a day.
ex.t: 在《省钱：美味食物》中，她每周走访一户不同的家庭，并在厨师马特·特巴特的帮助下，提供减少食物浪费的顶级建议，同时准备每天每户不到5英镑的食谱。

ex.s: Sometimes she prepares traditional Brazilian dishes ___48___ her native home; other times she ___49___ dinner courses with her favorite beers.
ex.t: 有时她准备传统巴西菜肴___48___她的家乡；其他时候她____49____搭配她最爱的啤酒的晚餐菜肴。

defs.def: to make yourself ready to do sth or for sth that you expect to happen 使（自己）有准备；防范

ex.s: She had prepared lots of snacks, while my job was to have the backyard in order.
ex.t: 社会比较会使我们陷入情绪困扰

ex.s: Nothing in my life before prepared me ____58____ this one-and to be sure, the first time I came here I never imagined I would ever feel comfortable in this area.
ex.t: 我这辈子没有准备过这个____58____... 确定我第一次来这里... ...我从未想过我会在这片区域感到舒服

ex.s: Most of Ho’s students will recover, which means that preparing them to return to school is an increasingly important component of care.
ex.t: Ho的大多数学生都会康复，这意味着帮助他们重返校园正成为照护中越来越重要的组成部分。

ex.s: After Charlie had a heart attack, Tindale says, she was prepared to put him to sleep, but Farber’s treatments eased her dog’s suffering so much that she was able to keep him alive for an additional five months.
ex.t: Charlie心脏病发作后，Tindale说，她本准备让它安乐死，但Farber的治疗大大减轻了它的痛苦，让她又能让它多活了五个月。

ex.s: PASS involves weekly sessions where you work in groups to tackle specially prepared problem sets, based around a unit of study you’re enrolled in.
ex.t: PASS包含每周的小组活动，你以小组形式攻克特别准备的问题集，围绕你所修的一个学习单元。

ex.s: What do you need to prepare？
ex.t: 你需要准备什么？

defs.def: to make food ready to be eaten 预备（饭菜）；做（饭）

ex.s: My mom told me how to preparing it.
ex.t: 妈妈告诉我怎么做这道菜。

ex.s: The first dish Oliver prepared for his family was fried chicken wings.
ex.t: 奥利弗为家人做的第一道菜是炸鸡翅。

ex.s: Good Morning Britain’s Susanna Reid is used to grilling guests on the sofa every morning, but she is cooking up a storm in her latest role — showing families how to prepare delicious and nutritious meals on a tight budget.
ex.t: 《早安英国》的苏珊娜·里德习惯每天早上在沙发上盘问嘉宾，但在她最新的角色里，她正大显身手——教家庭如何在预算紧张的情况下准备美味又营养的饭菜。

ex.s: There you will find them prepared differently- more dumpling and less soup, and the wrappers are pressed ____40____ hand rather than rolled.
ex.t: 在那里，你会发现小笼包的做法不同——馅更多、汤更少，而且面皮是____40____手按压而不是擀出来的。

ex.s: And the Good Morning Britain presenter says she’s been able to put a lot of what she’s leant into practice in her own home, preparing meals for sons, Sam, 14, Finn, 13, and Jack, 11.
ex.t: 这位《早安英国》主持人说，她已能把学到的很多东西付诸自家实践，为14岁的萨姆、13岁的芬恩和11岁的杰克三个儿子做饭。

ex.s: He prepares food for her kids.
ex.t: 他为她孩子做饭。

defs.def: to make a medicine or chemical substance, for example by mixing other substances together 调制，配制（药品等）

ex.s: We began preparing the food, from mixing salad dressing to separating frozen meat.
ex.t: 我们开始准备食物，从调制沙拉酱到分拣冷冻肉类。
